state_change_proposals: Dates: 299th–303rd the leg (the Stair's bowl 300th; Oryn's road turned at a cairn 301st — she walked on; the Hall's marsh 302nd; the crest 303rd); the fight and the Span the 304th. Cash 123.

THE WATCH-POST: timber hut, fire, a hide over kit, a two-timber barricade across the shelf; seven hooded, two crossbows, one low practitioner; expected six; broke east along the perimeter at eleven seconds; not pursued. Seln: the iron 'years, not one winter' (no number).
TERRAIN: the shelf a cart's width between the sink (a drop of three men's height onto loose stone) and the iron; the line a stride past the iron; 'There was no round.'
FRAGMENT THIRTEEN: Force-adjacent (Teague; partial; Bronze) — notice as logged; it LISTENS (wants a thing to push against; the ribs know the cost).

COSTS: Teague's wrist, elbow and shoulder along the line ('a third time on that arm and I'll set it in a splint'); the broad man's leg broken above the ankle at the sink's edge — set and knit by Oryn in one holding, bears in three days, limps worse; Oryn a quarter of an hour grey on the slope ('Nobody died of that'); the other healer NODDED (second exchange). Brom took two bolts on Iron (shoulder, forearm) — no wound entered beyond a bruise. Vastin over the iron on the knee (day 25).
Teague said 'Noted' twice (the crest; the arm). Karis: 'They knew.'

THE SPAN: an arch of seamless grey stone on two piers over the sink; the crown taller than a man; carvings on the piers' inner faces (same make), copied; the bearing 'Through' — the span's line and the sites' line the same; nothing happened to Cael on the crown; the mule stayed at the hut.
deviations: 'four hundred metres' appears (distance, B7's figure) — not 'four hundred years'.

READER STANDARD (Gate 27): banned-word grep 0; no profanity or oaths; violence with cost and without gore; no sexual content; the crew's conduct decent. The watch are people on a posting; nobody dies; nobody is pursued.
READER STANDARD (Gate 27): banned-word grep 0; a fight with cost and without gore; nobody killed; the watch not pursued and treated humanely; no sexual content.

r2 (repairs of r1 STRUCTURAL_HOLD): the third exchange RESTAGED — five over the iron (Cael, Lira, Karis, the young one, Vastin) level with four on the shelf (Brom, the broad man, Teague, the tall woman): a line wider than the shelf, walked forward without striking; the watch gives ground to the PINCH by the hut's far wall (a stride and a half between the drop and the iron), where seven cannot stand in a line and the only room is inside the iron, which they will not take; the perimeter road at their backs a pace wide; eleven seconds; 'You'll die in there.' / 'We've been in three times.'; they go east one at a time; no pursuit. THE COUNT: nine on the path (Karis and the young one on it; Seln along the perimeter); ten on the count with Seln; the healers and the mule off it; the broad man stays on the slope with the healer of no Path and the mule; nine and Oryn and Karis's case and the young one's box go in. DATES: Stair's bowl the 299th by dusk; Oryn's cairn and the Hall's marsh the 300th; three days Hall→crest (301st–303rd). BROM'S BILL: a week of colours on the forearm and the unbound shoulder. Trims for the band.
